changes: Default keyed fixture uses a selector, per-row label signals, textContent and stable row captures.
Compiler marks fresh-template physical paths whose resolutions precede bindings; hydration retains logical matching.
Runtime traverses fresh paths with firstChild/nextSibling and reuses successful DOM-brand validation.
Fixed textContent property bindings avoid generic property dictionaries while retaining DOM property coercion.
Render effects with no subscriptions, owned children or cleanup release their graph ownership after the initial body.
Root mount state is stored on the root and cleanup context nesting is reduced.
An exclusively owned list container uses replaceChildren with the existing start/end markers; shared containers retain bounded Range deletion.
Keyed item tracking nodes are allocated on the first tracked read, preserving later subscriptions and same-object notifications.
Destroying a root clears deferred ref state only when it was allocated.
